SeriousDlqin2yrs.description: Person experienced 90 days past due delinquency or worse within a 2-year performance window.
SeriousDlqin2yrs.values: 0 = No serious delinquency, 1 = Serious delinquency (90+ days past due)
SeriousDlqin2yrs.benchmark: 6.68% historical default rate in Give Me Some Credit

RevolvingUtilizationOfUnsecuredLines.description: Total balance on credit cards and personal lines of credit (excluding real estate and installment debt) divided by the sum of credit limits.

age.description: Age of the borrower in completed years.

NumberOfTime30-59DaysPastDueNotWorse.description: Number of times borrower has been 30-59 days past due but no worse in the last 2 years.
NumberOfTime30-59DaysPastDueNotWorse.values: 0 to 15 (Values 96 and 98 denote special coding/unrecorded in raw Kaggle files)

DebtRatio.description: Monthly debt payments, alimony, and living costs divided by monthly gross income.
DebtRatio.values: 0.00 to 1.00+ (In raw dataset, when income is missing, reflects absolute monthly debt obligations)

NumberOfOpenCreditLinesAndLoans.description: Number of open credit facilities (installment loans such as auto/student loans and revolving credit lines).

NumberOfTimes90DaysLate.description: Number of times borrower has been 90 days or more past due in the past 2 years. Primary leading indicator of severe delinquency.

NumberRealEstateLoansOrLines.description: Number of active mortgage and real estate loans including home equity lines of credit.

NumberOfTime60-89DaysPastDueNotWorse.description: Number of times borrower has been 60-89 days past due but no worse in the last 2 years.

NumberOfDependents.description: Number of family dependents excluding the borrower (~2.6% missing in benchmark dataset).
